spells.tm: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage
1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell
1 reaction, which you take when you or a creature within 60 feet of you falls
1 reaction, which you take when you speak to another creature
1 reaction, which you take in response to being damaged by a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see
1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the {@spell magic missile} spell
1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw
1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies
1 reaction, taken when a creature you can see makes an attack roll or starts to cast a spell
